main.description: A user-defined tag for organizing saved places. Record key is the slug (any valid record key). Places reference tags by strongRef, so renaming a label updates everywhere.

slug.description: Stable identifier, also the record key. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It does not change when the label is renamed.

label.description: The tag name the user sees.

color.description: Display colour as a hex value, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.
